summary: Backend digest feature fully tested. 19/19 pytest tests passed covering /admin/digest/{send,preview,test-send,runs} with auth guards (401/403), data correctness (rider spend >= fare, captain earnings >= fare, admin revenue >= fare), Resend integration via delivered@resend.dev, digest_runs history, APScheduler startup ('Digest scheduler started (Mondays 08:00 IST)' present in backend logs), and regression on existing endpoints (/auth/dev-login, /auth/me, /rides POST, /rides/pending, /admin/overview, /admin/revenue/weekly). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: digest.py send_weekly_digests uses `datetime.now() - 7d` sliding window instead of Mon 00:00 IST -> Mon 08:00 IST anchor. Works fine for weekly cron since it runs weekly, but overlaps if triggered manually mid-week. Not a bug per PRD.
server.py is 1099 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth, rides, admin, digest) modules for maintainability.
Preview endpoint accepts admin's own email as default for rider/captain kinds and would 404 if admin not registered as such role — acceptable, returns proper 404.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed riders/captains via dev-login and completed rides via admin force-complete inside pytest fixtures. Data persists in test DB (not cleaned up — used TEST_ prefix for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Digest feature is production-ready. Public URL: https://rideshare-mvp-21.preview.emergentagent.com. Full digest send took ~30s due to Resend proxy calls. Note: Resend proxy actually accepts @example.com addresses and returns 202 (they count as 'riders'/'captains' sent, not 'failed'). Only truly undeliverable domains like @nafisride.local return 422 -> counted as failed. Test asserts failed>0 was satisfied by the admin@nafisride.local recipient (1 failure).
